Setup API calls created some prerequisites and API readbacks confirmed saved values and refusals; the article steps themselves were performed in the browser. See the observations in walkthrough-r1.json.

Creating a Contract through an Auto-Doc Generation was not exercised; source inspection in technical-review.json covers that sentence.
